name: ai-research-assistant
description: Local scaffold for the AI Research Assistant.

scripts.dev: concurrently --kill-others-on-fail --names worker,frontend --prefix-colors magenta,cyan "npm run dev:worker" "npm run dev:frontend"
scripts.db:migrate:local: wrangler d1 migrations apply DB --config wrangler.jsonc --local --persist-to .wrangler/state
scripts.typecheck: tsc --noEmit --project tsconfig.app.json && tsc --noEmit --project tsconfig.worker.json && tsc --noEmit --project tsconfig.vite.json
scripts.build: npm run typecheck && npm run build:frontend && npm run build:worker
